# Hagerstone International

> India's premier interior design & build company with 11+ years of experience, 7M+ sqft delivered across 25+ cities in 7 countries. We specialize in turnkey corporate interiors, MEP, EPC, and PEB solutions.

## About Us
Hagerstone International Pvt. Ltd. is a design-build firm headquartered in Delhi NCR, India. We provide end-to-end interior design, construction, and engineering services for corporate offices, commercial spaces, hospitality, retail, and industrial projects.

## Services Offered
- Interior Design & Space Planning
- Turnkey Fit-Out Solutions
- Corporate Office Interiors
- Hospitality & Retail Design
- MEP (Mechanical, Electrical, Plumbing)
- HVAC & Fire Safety Systems
- EPC (Engineering, Procurement, Construction)
- PEB (Pre-Engineered Buildings)
